newsitem.title: USA: First Financial sees Q2 charge $0.67/shr.
newsitem.headline: First Financial sees Q2 charge $0.67/shr.

text.p: First Financial Bancorp Inc on Monday it expected to record an estimated charge of $280,000, net of tax, or $0.67 a share, in the second quarter, subject to market conditions.

The charge will reflect a move to restructure its balance sheet, including losses taken on the sale of about $20 million fixed-rate first mortgage loans and mortgage-backed securities and collateralized mortgage obligations with a market value of $8 million, it said.
The company said in a statement that the impact on book value per share is about $0.28.
No one at the company's offices in Illinois responded to a call Monday evening seeking further information.
The company statement said it was seeking to cut its exposure to rising market interest rates by improving its net interest margin.
